items.title: Ancient Bitcoin Wallets Just Moved Again After a Decade
points: Wallets inactive for approximately 10 years transferred coins, marking a significant break in dormancy patterns
Movement of early-era Bitcoin holdings typically draws market attention due to the size and historical significance of these positions
Reactivation of such old wallets can trigger volatility as traders speculate about seller intentions or holder motivations

items.title: Solana Payment Channels: Infrastructure for AI Agent Commerce
points: 1 million unique wallets processed over 1 million payments per second in benchmarks—equivalent to 80 billion daily payments—at $0.0078 per million transactions

Agents authorize a spending ceiling once, then execute off-chain signed messages at zero per-call cost, with the full session settling in a single on-chain transaction across x402 and MPP protocols (payment channel protocols enabling continuous spending authorization without repeated on-chain approval)

Funds remain non-custodial throughout, held in program-controlled escrow rather than operator-controlled balances, eliminating prepaid credit model risks where service providers track balances off-chain
Spec is public and open source; Alibaba Cloud launched live inference endpoints using payment channels on day one, showing production-grade adoption

items.title: Liquid Network Security Incident and Pause
points: ~4,000 BTC (~$320M) withdrawn from Liquid's federation wallet (a multi-party controlled custodial account on the Bitcoin sidechain) by purported white-hat hackers using the SideSwap Peg-out Authorization Key

Blockstream paused the network and exchanges suspended LBTC (Liquid Bitcoin) deposits/withdrawals; an on-chain message stated 'We are whitehats, contact us on chain,' suggesting disclosure rather than market dumping
No confirmation yet on fund recovery or network restart timeline; only LBTC was affected, while other Liquid-issued assets remained unimpaired
Blockstream indicated the authorization key itself was not compromised, narrowing the attack surface to how the key was stored or accessed by SideSwap

items.title: Block's Path to a Payment Network
points: Block controls millions of Square merchants and 60M+ daily Cash App users, and its new 'Neighborhoods' feature routes payments directly between Block-owned accounts via Cash App Pay at just 1% cost while bypassing Visa/Mastercard networks

Future phases target non-Square merchant access (leveraging fraud intelligence from Cash App's user base) and eventual registration as an official debit network accepting all cards, positioning Block as a fifth network rivaling Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and Discover
Profitability at 1% cost indicates Block can maintain margins while undercutting legacy networks; direct routing between Cash App accounts eliminates intermediaries and settlement delay
This strategy mirrors how Stripe and Square disrupted merchant acquiring, now extended to network-layer payment infrastructure

items.title: Coinbase Derivatives Expansion and Institutional Finance
points: Coinbase filed SEC-notice registrations for a derivatives exchange and broker, positioned to offer single-stock perpetual futures (leveraged contracts tracking individual stock prices that never expire, unlike traditional stock options) to US traders
Dual regulatory coordination with SEC and CFTC marks a shift toward pulling crypto-native derivative structures into onshore regulated markets rather than relying on offshore venues

Single-stock perpetuals have exploded in offshore crypto exchanges but are tightly restricted or banned onshore; Coinbase's move brings structural innovation under formal US oversight for the first time

items.title: BitGo Acquires NYDIG Trading Arm
points: BitGo is acquiring NYDIG's trading arm for $42.5M in cash and stock plus a $15M earnout
Deal integrates institutional trading infrastructure into BitGo's custody and settlement stack
